# uwuFeed

> Push first feed aggregator. Follow a YouTube channel, a blog, a subreddit
> or anything with a feed, and the new post arrives in seconds rather than
> minutes. Free for users, with one ingestion pipeline and four delivery
> channels: the web app, Telegram, Discord and ntfy.

The design decision everything else follows from: when a source is added,
uwuFeed fetches it once and looks for `<link rel="hub">`. A hub means the
publisher will announce changes, so the source joins the push tier and is
never polled. No hub means the poll tier, with conditional requests and an
interval that adapts between 60 seconds and an hour. That one check at
signup is the difference between two second and thirteen minute latency.

Documentation pages are Markdown, served from `content/` and rendered
client side. Each link below is the raw source, which is the best thing to
read.
